[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] '''Thom Clessigan''' was assigned to operate undercover in [[Glorga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] organization on [[Hollast VII]] as one of the gangster's lieutenants. Clessigan witnessed the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] kill fellow agent [[Lanish Ran]] in the [[Spilgan complex]]. Clessigan promptly arrested Ran's killer.<ref name="AJ1" />

Clessigan took the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Protector (shuttle)|''Protector'']] to transport Nakaron to the Republic detention facility on [[Dles IV]]. On route, Nakaron escaped and hijacked the shuttle, taking Clessigan and the crew hostage.<ref name="AJ1" />
